about_the_game:
This DLC contains the Dimension "Lost in The Forest". In it, you will have 5 musical themes, 5 ambient sounds and 10 stingers, all in the aesthetic of the D&D genre. All that in the palm of your hand. The Dimension details are as follows:

D0009: Lost in The Forest

Discover the mysteries of a green and vast world, experiencing dangers and intrigue
Paid Dimension (DLC)

- Genre: D&D

- Tracks:

  • Mistery (theme for investigative moments)

  • Run and Attack (theme for combat situations)

  • Friends (theme for calm and still moments)

  • Walk (theme for wandering and travelling moments)

  • Forest (theme for a forest scenery)

- Composer: Arlam Junior
